exposure: Lowest median ZIP code income quartile
Chronic medical conditions (obesity, pregestational diabetes, chronic hypertension)
Infection during delivery hospitalization (intra-amniotic infection, endometritis, wound infection, delivery sepsis)
cohort: The study included 15,268,190 delivery hospitalizations and 256,216 associated 60-day postpartum readmissions for females aged 15-54 years.
finding: Sepsis accounts for a significant proportion of postpartum readmissions and is a major contributor to adverse outcomes during delivery hospitalizations and postpartum readmissions, with specific maternal characteristics and infections identified as risk factors.
